notes: POST HOC (not pre-registered): requested after the pre-registered A2 results were seen. The pre-registered A2 results and verdicts in A2_hazard_ppo.json are unchanged; this file re-evaluates PA1-PA5 and PA7 on the corrected grid (verdicts_post_hoc, same operationalisations as A2). PA6 is not re-evaluated (no ledger cells were retrained); compliance is reported per cell.

The raw threat is quantised in steps of 1/3 (tau = 0, 1/3, 2/3 on the three observations before impact for a stationary agent), so tau_on = 0.34 engaged the reflex only one step before impact: one 0.5 dodge step, less than the 0.6 hit radius, while the reflex rule (time_to_impact <= 2) needs two. Corrected: tau_on = 1/3 - 1e-6, tau_off = 1/6, so the gate engages two steps before impact.

Retrained: (b), (c), (d) (the planner adapts to the reflex, as in A2). (e) reflex_only has no trainable parameters: evaluated at the corrected thresholds, 5 identical 'seeds' (zero-width CI). (a), (f) have no gate: their A2 runs (same jobs, same seeds) are reused unchanged.
Metrics, evaluation protocol and bootstrap as in A2 (see A2_hazard_ppo.json notes). comparison_with_A2: corrected minus pre-registered A2 cell, unpaired two-sample bootstrap.

(b) vs (c) at the corrected thresholds: the hysteresis band tau in [1/6, 1/3) corresponds to time_to_impact > 2, where the reflex rule never fires, and an engaged reflex that does not fire passes the queued action through; so (b) and (c) can differ only in the gate bookkeeping (switches, chatter, reflex_fraction). b_vs_c_behaviour_identical_per_seed compares every other evaluation number seed by seed.

parameters.base_experiment: A2_hazard_ppo (every parameter identical except the gate thresholds)
parameters.bootstrap_difference: unpaired two-sample percentile bootstrap, 10 000 resamples, seed 0

evaluation.episode_seeds: episode i reset with eval_seed + i (common to all runs, as in A2)

post_hoc_reason: The raw threat is quantised in steps of 1/3 (tau = 0, 1/3, 2/3 on the three observations before impact for a stationary agent), so tau_on = 0.34 engaged the reflex only one step before impact: one 0.5 dodge step, less than the 0.6 hit radius, while the reflex rule (time_to_impact <= 2) needs two. Corrected: tau_on = 1/3 - 1e-6, tau_off = 1/6, so the gate engages two steps before impact.

cells.source: re-evaluated at the corrected thresholds (no trainable parameters)

predictions.PA1: PA1 (reflex works): (b) has fewer hits per episode than (a) by at least 50 %, and higher time_in_V; the 5-seed bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0.
predictions.PA2: PA2 (hysteresis): (c) has at least 1.5× the gate switch rate of (b) and a higher chatter rate; its hits are not lower than (b)'s (CI of hits(c) − hits(b) does not exclude 0 from above... state: lower bound of CI ≥ −0.2).
predictions.PA3: PA3 (slow gate is late): (d) has more hits per episode than (b); CI of the difference excludes 0.
predictions.PA4: PA4 (gate recovers the monolith): hits(b) ≤ hits(f) + 0.5·(hits(a) − hits(f)), i.e. the gate closes at least half of the gap between the delayed planner and the no-delay monolith.
predictions.PA5: PA5 (task is not sacrificed): task return of (b) ≥ 0.8 × task return of (a).
predictions.PA7: PA7 (reflex alone is not enough): (e) has task return < 0.25 × task return of (b).

PA1.operationalisation: held iff mean hits_per_episode(b) <= 0.5 * mean hits_per_episode(a) AND mean time_in_V(b) > mean time_in_V(a) AND the 95 % CI of hits(a) - hits(b) excludes 0 AND the 95 % CI of time_in_V(b) - time_in_V(a) excludes 0 ('the difference' read as both differences; held_if_ci_on_hits_only also stored).
PA1.prediction: PA1 (reflex works): (b) has fewer hits per episode than (a) by at least 50 %, and higher time_in_V; the 5-seed bootstrap CI of the difference excludes 0.

PA2.operationalisation: held iff mean gate_switches_per_100(c) >= 1.5 * mean gate_switches_per_100(b) AND mean chatter_per_100(c) > mean chatter_per_100(b) AND lower bound of the 95 % CI of hits(c) - hits(b) >= -0.2.
PA2.prediction: PA2 (hysteresis): (c) has at least 1.5× the gate switch rate of (b) and a higher chatter rate; its hits are not lower than (b)'s (CI of hits(c) − hits(b) does not exclude 0 from above... state: lower bound of CI ≥ −0.2).

PA3.operationalisation: held iff mean hits(d) > mean hits(b) AND the 95 % CI of hits(d) - hits(b) excludes 0.
PA3.prediction: PA3 (slow gate is late): (d) has more hits per episode than (b); CI of the difference excludes 0.

PA4.operationalisation: held iff mean hits(b) <= mean hits(f) + 0.5 * (mean hits(a) - mean hits(f)).
PA4.prediction: PA4 (gate recovers the monolith): hits(b) ≤ hits(f) + 0.5·(hits(a) − hits(f)), i.e. the gate closes at least half of the gap between the delayed planner and the no-delay monolith.

PA5.operationalisation: held iff mean task_return(b) >= 0.8 * mean task_return(a).
PA5.prediction: PA5 (task is not sacrificed): task return of (b) ≥ 0.8 × task return of (a).

PA7.operationalisation: held iff mean task_return(e) < 0.25 * mean task_return(b).
PA7.prediction: PA7 (reflex alone is not enough): (e) has task return < 0.25 × task return of (b).
